values.task_boundary: Implement, prove, independently review, publish, shepherd, and merge the issue #132 authority snapshot accessors without implementing issue #5877 projections.
deliverables: Revisioned redacted failure-detection authority snapshot with missing members
Revisioned redacted complete lease authority snapshot
Revisioned redacted complete fencing-floor authority snapshot
Revisioned redacted migration and recovery snapshots with restart parity
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: Every accessor returns complete deterministic bounded rows and an authority-owned revision/checkpoint without public row constructors.
AC-2: Authoritative mutations advance the revision, and an N/N+1 guarded read fails closed on drift.
AC-3: Certificate rows expose only redacted generation/status metadata and correctly represent current-generation overlap.
AC-4: Failure-detection rows explicitly represent unavailable or missing members without exposing raw probe evidence.
AC-5: Placement snapshots retain current decisions and correctly reflect replacement and removal.
AC-6: Migration and recovery snapshots enumerate complete state and reproduce the same rows and revision after snapshot restore.
AC-7: Focused tests and strict Clippy pass, and exact-head review has no actionable findings.
dependencies: Merged distributed guardian authority implementations on origin/main
non_goals: Adding caller-created snapshot or proof constructors
Exposing secret or raw authority evidence
Changing distributed module registration or Cargo manifests unless unavoidable for compilation
